description: This Java file contains unit tests for the Condition class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the match functionality between condition instances.

classes.name: ConditionTest
classes.description: Test class for the Condition class, verifying the behavior of the matches method under different scenarios.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes the baseCondition object and its associated fields before each test.

methods.name: matches_shouldReturnFalseIfNoFieldsHaveChanged
methods.description: Tests that the match method returns true when no fields have been changed between two identical Condition instances.

methods.name: matches_shouldReturnFalseIfOnlyIdentityFieldsHaveChanged
methods.description: Tests that the match method ignores changes in identity fields such as id and uuid.

methods.name: matches_shouldReturnTrueIfNonIdentityFieldsHaveChanged
methods.description: Checks that modifications to non-identity fields result in the match method returning false, confirming proper field comparison logic.
